R4A-bear-backcountry-0004.name: By Deer Creek
R4A-bear-backcountry-0004.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R4A-bear-backcountry-0004.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: Cutblock harvested 2012 (14 years old), 110 m SE: cutblocks and logging road edges green up first in spring (65%) and grow berries for the fall feed (lesson: Black bear).
S facing slope, 17 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Deer Creek 110 m SE: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

flags.t: Spot is inside a Motor Vehicle for Hunting Closed Area: Deer Creek Road. Closed September 1 to November 30. Synopsis map 2-46/23.

Region 4: it is unlawful to feed or bait deer, elk, moose and other hoofed game, or turkeys, anywhere in the Kootenay Region (synopsis page 37, 99%). Snowmobiles may not be used for hunting in Region 4 from 1 April to 30 November (page 37, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: bag 2; private land only, with landowner permission

plan: Drive: from City of Rossland, about 65 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.5622, -117.97099, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 5.1 km S, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 345 m, about 135 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 320 m SW of the spot at 1,212 m (49.51604, -117.99256). Water: Deer Creek right here (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 4-15, Region 4. No baiting in Region 4. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4A-bear-backcountry-0004.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 4-15: about 361 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.20 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

R4A-grouse-atv-0003.name: By Grizzly Creek
R4A-grouse-atv-0003.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R4A-grouse-atv-0003.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Grizzly Main); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
24 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.
